info.name: Starbridge External Public Bridges Signal API

params.name: triggerIds
params.description: Limit results to signals from these bridge ids.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort field. Date = by signal date, Hotness = by hotness score. Always descending. Date is the default.

params.name: buyerId
params.description: UUID of the buyer whose signals to return.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by row status. Defaults to New when omitted.

params.name: relativeDatePeriodFrom
params.description: Lower bound on the signal date as a relative period.

items.docs: Returns the most recent Starbridge signals (bridge rows) for a given buyer within the organization. A signal pairs a bridge (the monitoring definition) with a row (a concrete match). Supports filtering by bridge ids, bridge filter types, row statuses, and a relative date period. Default sort is by signal date (most recent first); pass sort=Hotness to rank by hotness score. All sorts are descending.

items.docs: Returns the top recent Starbridge signals (bridge rows) across the whole organization, regardless of buyer. A signal pairs a bridge (the monitoring definition) with a row (a concrete match). Supports filtering by bridge ids, bridge filter types, row statuses, and a relative date period. Default sort is by hotness score (highest first); pass sort=Date to rank by signal date. All sorts are descending.
